terminal.empty: No events registered on the serial channel. Awaiting bus activity...

pin1.critical_note: LOW forces serial boot via XFWE (cuts off Q7514 TX). Keep Hi-Z for normal TX and NEVER power the Pico through this pin.

pin3.signal_name: UART TX -> AM34 RX via Q7514
pin3.critical_note: 10kΩ R7570 pull-up to NSW5V. Requires SW_UART=Hi-Z so Q7514 conducts toward AM34 SoC.

pin4.critical_note: Service manual P7501 B6B-ZR-3R4 = PIN 4 (0.0V common reference). Always verify 0.0Ω continuity before powering on.

pin5.critical_note: CRITICAL: On DMR-EH55 P7501 Pin 5 is the NSW5V rail (from IC1506 ~5.15V via D7510). ALWAYS keep as Hi-Z Input with no pulls — NEVER drive push-pull!

pin6.critical_note: Only active UART TX line observed on DMR-EH55 P7501 (10kΩ R7572 pull-up to NSW5V).

mode0.label: Mode 0: Normal Hi-Z (SW_UART Open)
mode0.description: Keeps SW_UART (GP26) in Hi-Z during XRESET open-drain pulse; Q7514 stays conducting UARTM2P_T -> AM34.

mode1.label: Mode 1: Serial Pulse (XFWE Pre-Reset)
mode1.description: Pulses SW_UART LOW only across XRESET release, then restores GP26 to Hi-Z to enable bidirectional TX after handshake.
mode1.signal_diagram: SW_UART: Pulse Low -> Hi-Z | Q7514 Re-enabled

mode2.label: Mode 2: JIG Hold LOW (SW_UART Latched)
mode2.description: Standard JIGBOOT mode for AM34 UART capture: holds SW_UART LOW via Q7510 across boot window before returning to Hi-Z.
mode2.signal_diagram: SW_UART: Hold Low -> Isolate Hi-Z | 115200 8N1 RX

mode3.label: Mode 3: Extended Hi-Z (Long Capture)
mode3.description: Performs open-drain XRESET pulse while keeping UART lines in Hi-Z listen mode for full CDDIAG and DDR CHECK traces.
mode3.signal_diagram: XRESET: Open-Drain | GP2 RX + GP3 NSW5V Hi-Z

PINCHECK.label: Electrical Matrix (PINCHECK)
PINCHECK.description: Audits all 6 pins on P7501 across Hi-Z, Pull-Down, and Pull-Up states plus XRESET rise time.

BUSDIAG.label: Contention & Boot (BUSDIAG)
BUSDIAG.description: Sweeps GP4/UARTM2P_T drive strengths (2..12 mA) and compares GP2 UART RX profiles with SW_UART Hi-Z vs LOW.

SNIFF.label: Passive Monitor (SNIFF)
SNIFF.description: Counts passive edge transitions on GP2..GP5 over a configurable sampling window (ms).

ISOLATE.label: Isolate Bus (Hi-Z)
ISOLATE.description: Switches GP2..GP5 to high impedance so probe lines do not load normal DMR-EH55 boot.

ENGAGE.label: Engage UART / PIO
ENGAGE.description: Activates 3.3V P7501 PIO / UART signaling while holding NSW5V (GP3) strictly in Hi-Z.

RESET.label: Open-Drain XRESET Pulse
RESET.description: Pulls XRESET to 0V in open-drain mode for 10 ms and releases back to Hi-Z.

HANDSHAKE.label: Execute JIG Boot
HANDSHAKE.description: Runs P7501 JIGBOOT sequence (SW_UART+XRESET) and captures initial boot ROM response.

BREAK_IN.label: Boot/Reset Profile
BREAK_IN.description: Applies discrete P7501 boot/reset profile (modes 0..3: Hi-Z, Serial Pulse, JIG Hold LOW, Extended).

SCAN.label: Probe UART Bus
SCAN.description: Audits electrical stability and automatically detects P7501 UART activity.

AUTODETECT.label: Autodetect Flash (Read-Only)
AUTODETECT.description: Measures passive address aliasing (2/4/8/16 MB) without writing to NOR Flash.

CFI.label: JEDEC CFI Query
CFI.description: Issues JEDEC 0x98 CFI query (Spansion QRY signature and 2^N geometry exponent).

FLASH_SIZE.label: Set Flash Geometry
FLASH_SIZE.description: Overrides expected NOR Flash capacity used for memory reads and GDB RSP XML maps.

DUMP.label: Memory Dump
DUMP.description: Reads 32-bit little-endian words from arbitrary AM34 SRAM, NOR Flash, or MMIO addresses.

BOOTCAP.label: Capture UART Boot (BOOTCAP)
BOOTCAP.description: Resets recorder and captures 115200 8N1 telemetry on GP2 during the configured window.

UARTMON.label: Passive UART Monitor
UARTMON.description: Listens passively on GP2 115200 8N1 without asserting XRESET on the recorder.

JIGBOOT.label: Jig Mode Boot (JIGBOOT)
JIGBOOT.description: Boots target SoC while holding SW_UART LOW across the capture window.

BAUD.label: Measure Baud Rate (PIO1)
BAUD.description: Measures the narrowest pulse width on GP2 via PIO1 and calculates the real SC0 baud rate.

BAUDSCAN.label: Sweep & Auto-Baud Boot
BAUDSCAN.description: Resets target via XRESET, measures real baud on GP2 and captures initial samples (optional APPLY).

UARTSTREAM.label: Zero-Drop PIO1 UART Stream
UARTSTREAM.description: Captures 115200 8N1 streaming on PIO1 with zero byte drop during boot and supports JIG:<hold_ms>.

HEXCAP.label: PIO1 Hex/Break Capture
HEXCAP.description: Displays raw UART stream in hex + ASCII with line break markers via PIO1.

UARTTXHEX.label: Deterministic Hex TX (PIO1)
UARTTXHEX.description: Transmits hexadecimal sequence (or BRK) on GP4 with PIO1 timing and captures response on GP2.

WAITTX.label: Deterministic Trigger & TX
WAITTX.description: Monitors boot stream until ASCII trigger is detected (e.g. wait 1) and injects hex payload or Break with optional Q7514 release.

PWRTRACE.label: Dual ADC0 + UART Profiler
PWRTRACE.description: Logs GP2/GP3 transitions and ADC0 (GP26) voltage alongside PIO1 UART stream to correlate rails with boot.

BRIDGE.label: Transparent UART Bridge
BRIDGE.description: Enters bidirectional USB CDC <-> P7501 passthrough mode (exit with +++ or 0x03 Ctrl+C).

FMUSCAN.label: FMU Bootrom Sweep (FMUSCAN)
FMUSCAN.description: Sweeps Panasonic Bootrom FMU handshake sequences across Wait/Serial windows.

FMUTEST.label: Inject FMU Hex Payload
FMUTEST.description: Sends arbitrary hex payload during SW_UART FMU handshake and records target echo.

FMUBATCH.label: FMU Multi-Command Batch
FMUBATCH.description: Runs automated Bootrom FMU handshake probes in controlled sequence.

UARTSEND.label: Send TX String P7501
UARTSEND.description: Sends ASCII + CRLF with SW_UART=Hi-Z default (Q7514 enabled) or LOW: prefix and captures 2.5s RX reply.

UARTPROBE.label: Interactive UART Probe
UARTPROBE.description: Tests stimulus modes 0..8 during boot to discover hidden UART/BREAK consoles.

PING.label: Ping USB CDC / BLE
PING.description: Verifies immediate responsiveness of the Pico firmware CLI layer.

STATUS.label: Read VDD/ADC Telemetry
STATUS.description: Samples target voltage on ADC0 (GP26) with active floating-pin detection.

BANNER.label: Firmware Version & Banner
BANNER.description: Displays full RP2040/RP2350 firmware build banner running on the probe.

LED.label: Onboard LED GP25 Mode
LED.description: Switches visual blink pattern on the Pico onboard LED (with manual polling lock) or restores AUTO.

BOOTSEL.label: Reboot to USB BOOTSEL
BOOTSEL.description: Reboots the Pico probe into USB Mass Storage bootloader (`RPI-RP2` / `RP2350`).
